decision: Do not promote this content. Vow-0 random building is still generically strong. Ash Vow-5 named-route spread is 31.25 percentage points; the weaker two routes fall below the diagnostic midpoint floor defined by the sampled top and its matched control. The observed 29/32 Smolder win rate is a ceiling-risk signal, not a protected holdout ceiling measurement.
method_boundaries: Both arms use the same native public-information combat procedure; no weaker random-play controller is substituted.
All assigned early losses and adverse outcomes are retained; raw rows, configuration, output and log hashes were recounted.
This is exploratory evidence, not admission of the signed C2 arm, a replacement detector or six causal packages.
C2 is top-cell based; do not invent a requirement for every named route to beat every control by 35pp.
No source/policy change during the completed batch; no main change, merge or P9 receipt.
next: A four-cell factor design separates broadly available support from conditional payoff changes. Retain stable native planning and test actual health removed separately from raw overkill-inclusive event damage. No changes to enemy HP/facets, vows or the coupled Shatter/Stun law are required for that design.
